rows.t: BACK IN TOWN. You kept everything you carried.
YOU REACHED THE END OF THE ROUTE.
Click a unit, then MOVE and a blue tile, or pick an action. Right click = back. D = danger tiles. TAB = next unit. E = end turn
Hard walk: everyone loses 1 HP and morale drops 5.
Rested. Everyone heals 2 HP and morale rises 5.
BIG RIVER. ox scared. lorem ipsum.
BUSH WITH BERRY. it move? lorem.
Your party hears wolves howling in the distance. Something seems to have riled them up. You begin to see pairs of eyes watch you through the trees.
Drag items to move them. R or right click turns an item. Drop an item on SELL to sell it.
Drag items to move them. R or right click turns an item. Items on a belt can be used in a fight. Drop food or a potion on a friend to use it.
Your pack is full. New items wait here until you make room, or leave them behind.
A friend needs this. It can't be thrown away.
%s takes the bag home and leaves the party until you are home too.
%s is back and unpacks the bag.
A friend needs this. It can't be sold.
The world map isn't ready yet.
NO ROOM FOR BOOK. sell stuff.
HELLO. me mayor. lorem ipsum ipsum.
GO FAR. me give more gold. now +%d. lorem.
OLD STORY ONE. lorem ipsum dolor ipsum.
OLD STORY TWO. lorem ipsum lorem.
SEE THE WALL. lorem ipsum ipsum.
%s: %d foes in reach must attack it
THEY LEAVE. THE FIGHT IS OVER.
%s gets a free hit on %s for walking away.
Light every tile a foe can hit on its next turn. Key: D.
End your turn. The foes move next. Key: E.
AUTO: NOBODY HURT FOR A WHILE. PARTY WINS
Friends standing next to you get +1 armor.
Standing on higher ground than your target: spell damage +1.
If you did not move this turn, +15% crit chance.
Your spells do 1 more damage and heal 1 more.
Cannot be pushed. Gains 1 HP at the start of each of its turns.
Arrows pass through: ranged hits do 2 less damage.
Attacks twice, each hit doing 1 less damage.
+1 damage on a foe that a friend is also next to.
A friend standing next to him heals 1 HP at the start of its turn.
Your plain attacks have a 30% chance to burn the target: it loses 1 HP at the start of each of its next 2 turns, through armor. A new burn renews it and does not stack.
Dagger hits poison the target: it loses 1 HP at the start of its next turn, through armor. A new hit renews it and does not stack.
After attacking, you may walk the rest of your move.
WASD = walk. Click a thing in reach to use it. F = use the nearest thing. Arrows or right drag = look around. Wheel = zoom
A stone door, carved with old markings.
A chest. There might be something good inside.
A strange stone stands here, humming softly.
A pile of rock blocks the stairs.
FOES AHEAD. THEY HAVE NOT SEEN YOU YET.
BEASTS AHEAD. THEY HAVE NOT CAUGHT YOUR SCENT YET.
SOMETHING STRANGE AHEAD. IT HAS NOT NOTICED YOU YET.
Pick a friend, then click a blue tile to place them. Quick friends can start far from the lead; heavy friends must stay close. ENTER = start the fight
Old weapons hang on the smithy's rack. Take one. You can come back and swap it any time.
A dusty old book sits on the shelf.
The door is stuck fast. It won't budge.
%s   LV %d   XP %d/%d\nHP %d/%d   DMG %d   ARMOR %d   CRIT +%d%%   MAGIC +%d
THE LODESTONE CAN STRENGTHEN A SKILL. PICK ONE (%d LEFT).
%s has a skill upgrade waiting. Open the Lodestone.
The dog has made himself at home here. He can come along, or stay and rest.
OPENS WHEN SOMEONE SETTLES HERE. SURVIVORS YOU MEET OUT IN THE WORLD MAY MOVE IN.
BEING REPAIRED. DONE AFTER YOUR NEXT TRIP.
EVERYTHING IS GATHERED. HEAD HOME TO START THE REPAIR.
A survivor with a smith's strong arms. They are looking for a place to live.
A survivor who smells of good cooking. They are looking for a place to live.
CAMP. Rest, drink a tonic or share a meal.
EVERYONE ATE. The meal's buff lasts for your next fights.
CLEAR HEAD: START FIGHT WITH +2 MANA, RAGE OR CHARGES
FOGGY HEAD: START FIGHT WITH -2 MANA, RAGE OR CHARGES
KEY FOUND! A locked door, cache or shortcut on this map can now be opened.
!! ELITE FOES. Tougher and harder hitting, but they pay 150% XP. You can walk away.
YOU WAKE IN THE SQUARE WITH EVERYTHING YOU CARRIED.
You wake up in the village square. The Lodestone is humming. It brought you back.
THE LICH KING IS BEATEN. THAT IS THE END OF THIS PLAYTEST: THANK YOU FOR PLAYING!
YOU HAVE THE LODESTONE. ITS BUTTON SITS AT THE BOTTOM RIGHT: OPEN IT ANY TIME FOR YOUR PARTY, OPTIONS AND SAVING.
Fish are swimming in the water below.
An old strongbox with a heavy lock. It needs a key.
The village gate. Past it, the road leads out into the world.
SOMETHING IN THE SQUARE IS CALLING YOU
A statue of an elf woman stands in the square. It wasn't here yesterday. In her outstretched hand she holds a glowing stone.
The door is locked. Somewhere inside, a dog is whimpering.
A small window, left open a crack. You could squeeze through.
A dog, shut in all alone. When he sees you, his tail starts to wag.
A coil of rope hangs on a hook.
A ledge high above. The rock is too steep to climb without a rope.
Your rope hangs down the rock face.
Something is buried under the snow.
Bones and scraps of old gear lie in a heap.
The Lich King waits on his throne.
Your party hears wolves howling in the distance. Something seems to have riled them up. You begin to see pairs of eyes watch you through the trees.
Bandits block the road and demand your supplies.
Someone dropped a bundle on the road. It looks like supplies.
An abandoned house stands by the road. It looks empty.
A freezing wind blows down from the mountains.
THAT PATH IS CLOSED FOR NOW.
NOT READY YET. TRY AGAIN IN A MOMENT.
Click a place to travel there. On the road you can hunt, fish, forage, talk or camp. FAST FORWARD (Tab) skips to each stop until you arrive.
NOBODY TO TALK TO ON THIS ROAD.
The dog looks up at you and wags his tail.
The dog sniffs the air. His ears perk up.
The dog drops a stick at your feet.
You should probably find something to protect yourself with before heading out!
A plain fire attack at one foe in your attack range (2 to 3 tiles to start). Damage is your attack damage, plus or minus 1. Ignores cover. Does 2 more to foes that burn easily. Free.
Attack with your weapon. Damage is your weapon damage, plus or minus 1. Free.
Hit an adjacent foe for 2 less damage and push it 1 tile away. 10% extra crit chance.
A careful shot: 1 more damage than a normal attack and 15% extra crit chance.
Hit a foe for 2 less damage and root it for 1 turn, so it cannot move. 5% extra crit chance.
Moon magic on the target tile and the 4 tiles next to it. Everything there takes 1 less than your spell damage, plus or minus 1. It hurts friends too.
Cover a friend in moonlight: they take 1 less damage from every hit until your next turn.
Fire on the target tile and the 4 tiles next to it. Everything there takes your spell damage, plus or minus 1. It hurts friends too.
Heal a friend, or yourself, for 4 HP plus your magic bonus.
Leap on an adjacent foe for 1 more damage than a normal attack and 10% extra crit chance.
Kick an adjacent foe for 1 less damage and push it 1 tile away. 5% extra crit chance.
Put a foe to sleep. It skips its next turn and cannot fight back. Any damage wakes it at once. Always lands.
A moon wave hits a foe for 3 less than your spell damage and pushes it 2 tiles away. 5% extra crit chance.
Mark a friend: they get 15% extra crit chance until your next turn.
A bolt of fire at one foe for 2 more than your spell damage, plus or minus 1.
Cold hits a foe for 2 less than your spell damage and roots it for 1 turn, so it cannot move. 5% extra crit chance.
Help up a downed friend next to you. They come back with 25% of their max HP.
Knock out a downed party piece next to you. It is out for the rest of this fight.
Bite an adjacent foe for normal damage and slow it: 2 less move for 1 turn.
Taunt: foes that can reach you must attack you, until your next turn.
Trail skills: what this character rolls with on the road, outside fights.
Who eats? Click their card (Esc cancels).
Who drinks? Click their card (Esc cancels).
Marks a plus-shaped area, then strikes it at the start of his next turn for 4 spell damage. It hits his own minions too. Step out of the marked tiles.
Raises 2 minions with 6 HP each next to the Lich, up to 4 at once. Used every 3 turns.
Stays hidden until a hero comes within 3 tiles. Its first strike from hiding counts as a flank.
The two of them sit and talk for a while.
Knocks a downed piece out for this fight
Can't be used again for %d turns
Grows 1 ice pillar next to your party, up to 8. A party piece loses 1 HP at the end of its turn for each pillar next to it, at most 2. A pillar has 6 HP and can be broken.
After you move, pick up an adjacent friend, standing or downed, and set them down up to 3 tiles further on.
Give up your action. A friend takes a full extra turn right away, move and action. Once every 3 turns.
Costs your action; a friend takes a full extra turn
Trade places with a friend up to 3 tiles away, even through foes, with no free hits. It uses your move, so you can still act after. Once every 3 turns.
Stay ready: until your next turn, the first foe to move into your bow's reach is stopped and shot once.
Protect a friend: the next hit on them does no damage and has no side effects. Lasts until it is used or your next turn.
Trades places. Uses your move, no free hits
If you do not move, you end your turn on watch: the first foe to walk into your bow's reach is stopped and shot once, until your next turn.
Taunt: foes that can reach you must attack you, until your next turn.
Sweep the target tile and the 4 tiles next to it with your weapon. Every foe there takes your damage, plus or minus 1.
Jump up to 3 tiles in one move, ignoring height.
Hit an adjacent foe for 1 more damage than a normal attack and 20% extra crit chance.
Fire at an area: everything on the target tile and the 4 tiles next to it takes 1 less than your normal damage. It hurts friends too.

Hide a trap on an empty tile 1 to 3 tiles away. The first foe to walk onto it stops there and takes your attack damage plus 2, less its armor; then the trap is gone. It lasts until the start of your next turn. Foes can't see it.
Hit a foe 2 to 4 tiles away for 3 less than your normal damage and pull it 2 tiles toward you. It stops early if something is in the way.
Give up your action: your dog, if within 4 tiles, takes a full extra turn right away, move and action.

Set a line of 2 tiles on fire, starting at a tile 2 to 4 tiles away and running away from you. Everyone standing there, friend or foe, takes your spell damage plus 1 and burns for 3 turns (1 HP at the start of each of their turns, through armor). Nobody can walk onto the burning tiles until the start of your next turn.

Blind every foe on a tile up to 3 tiles away and on the 4 tiles next to it, until the end of their next turn. A blinded foe can only attack what is right next to it, so bows and spells can't attack at all.
Help up a downed friend from up to 3 tiles away. They come back with 25% of their max HP.
Heal a friend for 1 HP plus your magic bonus now, then the same at the start of each of their next 3 turns.
A friend within 3 tiles, or you, can walk again this turn: a full move plus 1 tile.
Scare a foe 2 to 3 tiles away: it hits for 1 less damage during its next turn.
For you and friends within 3 tiles: anyone downed now gets 1 more turn before bleeding out, and anyone who falls before your next turn gets 1 more turn too.
You and friends within 2 tiles hit for 1 more damage for the rest of this turn.
Throw a bomb at the target tile and the 4 tiles next to it. Everything there takes 1 more than your normal damage. It hurts friends too.

Scatter spikes on an empty tile 1 to 3 tiles away. A foe walking onto it stops there, takes 2 less than your normal damage (less its armor) and is slowed: 2 less move for 1 turn. The spikes stay until the start of your next turn.
Heal an adjacent friend for 3 HP.
Throw smoke on a tile 2 to 3 tiles away and the 4 tiles next to it, until the start of your next turn. Nobody can attack from more than 1 tile away into, out of or across the smoke.
Heal an allied foe for 3 HP plus magic bonus.
Scare a hero: it hits for 1 less damage until the end of this phase.
Slow a hero: 2 less move for 1 turn.
A foe friend within range gets 2 extra armor until this foe's side next moves.
Hit an adjacent hero and push it 1 tile away.
Throw a dagger for 1 less than your normal damage and 10% extra crit chance. A short ranged attack to finish a foe.
RESTED. Mana and charges refill, and everyone heals half their max HP.
Tonic used. Everyone regains some mana or charges.
+2 armor until its next turn. Foes next to it must attack it or take a free hit when they walk away.
+1 armor until the caster's next turn.
Hits for 1 less damage until the end of this phase.
Foes that can reach it must attack it, until its next turn.
Skips its next turn and cannot fight back. Any damage wakes it.
15% extra crit chance until its next turn.
The next hit does no damage and has no side effects.
The first foe to move into its reach is stopped and shot once.
2 extra armor until the warder's side next moves.
Loses 1 HP at the start of each of its turns.
Loses 1 HP at the start of its next turn, through armor.
Loses 1 HP at the start of each of its turns while it burns, through armor.
Loses 1 HP at the end of its turn for each ice pillar next to it, at most 2.
Elite: 150% HP, 1 more damage, 1 more armor, and pays 150% XP.
Keep the pick for later: choose it any time from the Lodestone menu.
Not in the game yet: this ability is in the kit but its effect is still being built, so it cannot be picked.
The lock holds. No more tries on this visit.
It is empty. Nothing is put back once you have left the map.
No room for the rest: it stays here.
Guard: until your next turn you have +2 armor. A foe that starts its turn next to you can only attack you, and a foe that walks away from you takes a free hit.
The more hurt you are, the harder you hit: under half HP +1 damage, under a quarter +2, and +10% crit chance.
Your regular attack is two hits, each 1 weaker than one full hit.
A friend is waiting for you in the square. Do you want them to come along?
Bushberry has fallen. Help him up?
The dimmest embers remain in the center of this fire pit, they pulse up and down almost like they're breathing
Someone is asleep beside the fire. You could sit down on the log.
See a shadow in the water? Aim near it and cast.
WAIT... strike only on the real dip.
A FISH IS COMING TO THE BOBBER.
Reel in and aim again: click, SPACE or A (nothing lost)
TOO SOON! THE FISH WAS SPOOKED.
TOO SLOW. THE FISH IS GONE.
Aim near a fish shadow with the mouse, the arrows or a stick, then cast with a click, SPACE or A. A fish near the bobber may come to look.
Small dips are nibbles. Strike on the real dip: click, SPACE or A.
Then keep the fish inside the marker: hold left or right to pull it, let go and it drifts back. Stay on the fish until the meter under the bar fills.
Aim: mouse, arrows or stick|Cast: click, SPACE or A|Leave: ESC or B
Strike on the real dip: click, SPACE or A
Pull the marker: hold ← / →, A / D or the stick|Let go: it drifts back to the middle|Keep the fish inside it
Your own bed. You could sleep here and wake up rested.
SLEPT WELL. All HP, mana and charges restored. Everyone's morale +%d.
You already slept here this trip. Head out first.
Passive. Your regular attacks do 1 more damage and have 15% more crit chance. If a regular attack downs a foe, you can attack again right away from where you stand, once a turn.
A bolt that hits one foe for 1 less than your spell damage, plus or minus 1, and pulls it 1 tile toward you.
Wrap a friend in brittle bark. The next hit on them does 3 less damage (at least 1), and the piece that hit them takes 2 damage. Lasts until it is used or your next turn.
Friends standing next to you heal 1 HP at the start of each of their turns.
The next hit does 3 less damage, and the attacker takes 2 damage.
Not enough food. Morale drops 10 and everyone loses 2 HP.
OUT OF FOOD. THE LODESTONE PULLS YOU HOME.
Night camp: choose what each one eats
Not enough food: %d will go hungry tonight.
Not enough food: %d will go hungry tonight, but your first night out is free: no morale lost.
%s went hungry. First night out: no morale lost.
%s is Spent (0 morale): sits out fights until a rest or a full meal.
%s ate and is back on their feet (morale 10).
Spent: 0 morale. Sits out fights and earns no XP, but still walks and eats. A camp rest or a full meal brings them back to 10 morale.
Everyone was Spent, so the party was carried home. You kept your loot.
You have food for %d days with this party. Each day without food costs 15 morale. Leave anyway?
Your pack has no food for this party. Each day without food costs 15 morale. Leave anyway?
Goes to bed hungry with these picks and loses morale. Pick food for someone else to change who.
None left for this one tonight: the others eat it first.
Available after your first night at camp.
Pick the same food as last night.
First trip: %d rations added to your pack for free.
Sit down and eat. A dish eaten here gives double morale.
Who gets healed? Click their card (Esc cancels).
%s is free and joins your party.
%s is free, but the party is full. They head home.
Your regular attack. Hits an adjacent foe for normal damage plus 1 cold damage (through armor) and slows it: 2 less move for 1 turn.
Coat a friend 1 to 3 tiles away in ice for 2 turns. They get 1 more armor, and a foe that hits them has a 30% chance to be frozen after its hit: it skips its next turn.
A burst of cold around you. Every foe on the 4 tiles next to you takes 2 less than your normal damage (less its armor) and is slowed: 2 less move for 1 turn.

A hand rises from the ground on a tile 1 to 3 tiles away and stays for 2 turns. Every foe on it or the 4 tiles next to it takes 1 cold damage (through armor) and is slowed (2 less move) when it rises and at the start of each of its turns there; a foe that ends its move there is slowed through its next turn.
Skips its next turn and cannot fight back.
Eats no rations and is not healed by food. Camp rest, healing skills and belt items work as usual.
1 more armor. A foe that hits this piece may be frozen after its hit and skip its next turn.
The Lich King stays on his throne. He won't attack this time. You can pass, or fight him anyway.
The Lich King stops, one breath from falling. He offers you his son, the Lich Prince, as an apprentice.
The Lich King lets you pass.
Playtest build.  F12 saves a feedback note with a screenshot.
Every map, fight and tool. Games started there run in dev mode.
Start over? Your current save will be erased.
Not yet. Keep exploring the village.
Skips ahead to each stop on the road and stays on until you arrive. Press again (or Tab) to walk at normal speed.

Press D to light the tiles foes can reach next turn.
When everyone is done, press END TURN. Then the foes move.
Two wolves step onto the road ahead, teeth bared. There's no way around them.
The Lodestone carries you home. You keep everything you carried.
Each night after this eats the same food on its own. The camp still opens if someone would go hungry.
Camp: ate the same as last night.
